build: Modwerk's linker: core-ar2 0.7 + this folder's Pad Pressure Fix 0.2.0-experimental, materialised against stock OS 1.74, --version PF01

emulator.name: rytm-emu
emulator.settings: rytm-emu 2ac0f1f, card image made by the boot run, JIT on

conditions: Headless cold boot to 11000M on a fresh card with four held NO presses (8101M, 8601M, 9101M, 9601M, 12M each), saved as a snapshot; each capture resumes it. Frames are dtboot's firmware-rendered 128x64 screen at 3x, unmodified.

captures.plan: DTBOOT_STEPS=1 dtboot PF01.syx --load PF01.snap --card PF01.img --instr 5500M --every 1000M --press GLOBAL@11303M, DOWN at 11703M 11953M 12203M, YES@12553M, DOWN@12903M, YES@13253M, then DOWN every 250M from 13603M, ten times (12M presses). Byte-identical to 0.1.0's CA02 capture.
DTBOOT_STEPS=1 dtboot PF01.syx --load PF01.snap --card PF01.img --instr 1900M --every 1850M --press RTRG@11051M:800M, DOWN@11201M, DOWN@11301M, RIGHT@11401M, DOWN@11501M, YES@11601M (12M presses)
